title: Per-stage configuration values
description: Committed file `config/<target>/<stage>.json` (local: `config/local.json`; test stages, whose names start with `test-`: `config/<target>/test.json`). Owner: CFG. Behavior: docs/components/config.md. Secret values never appear here.

values.description: Values for the keys the app declares. Keys with defaults may be omitted; keys not declared by the app are rejected.

admins.description: User IDs of admins, as shown by /api/auth/me.

users.description: Optional list of user IDs, as shown by /api/auth/me, allowed to log in as `user`. When present, a validated login whose ID is in neither `users` nor `admins` is treated as anonymous. When absent, `user` means any account the login provider accepts. See docs/components/auth.md (AUTH-REQ-003).

email.description: Settings of the framework's own email (verification and reset links). Optional. Holds no address or domain: the sender is always `no-reply@<emailDomain>`, derived from the account's single email-domain setting (docs/components/mail.md, MAIL-REQ-003).

senderName.description: Display name of the sender, as in `<senderName> <no-reply@...>`. Default: the app name.
